proposals.direction: Pip tests the stone arch with one deliberate footfall and listens to the returning echo.
proposals.grounding: Pip is alone beneath the Echo Arch, whose stone returns each footfall; Pip currently has no established properties or traits.

proposals.direction: Pip traces a small ash mark on the stone to distinguish this moment from the next echo.
proposals.grounding: Pip is an ash-dusted frog at the bare Echo Arch, with no other local subject present and no current properties or traits.

proposals.direction: Pip settles motionless beneath the arch and waits to learn whether any sound arrives without a new footfall.
proposals.grounding: The Echo Arch is defined by returning footfalls, the recent record contains only Pip’s arrival, and Pip’s current state is empty.
